concrete.ef_source: IFC India Construction Materials Database (2017), Table 14, by cement type, CEA grid-adjusted.
concrete.unit_note: Convert Cum to kg using concrete density 2400 kg/m3 (IFC default), then apply per-kg factor.

paint.ef_source: Retained from the uploaded Embodied Carbon Contributor Flags sheet (ICE Database, Circular Ecology/Univ. of Bath) -- no defensible IFC India match found. (ICE paint, general, midpoint of water/solvent-based range).
paint.unit_note: NEEDS AREAL-MASS ASSUMPTION -- an area-priced row needs a kg/m2 conversion figure; only aluminium (12 kg/m2) and glass (15 kg/m2) have a documented assumption so far. Paint's own areal-mass figure is still open.

plaster_gypsum.ef_source: IFC India Construction Materials Database (2017), Table 14 -- Gypsum plaster. Raw value, NOT CEA-adjusted.
plaster_gypsum.unit_note: NEEDS AREAL-MASS ASSUMPTION -- an area-priced row needs a kg/m2 conversion figure; only aluminium and glass have one so far.

steel_gi_galvanized.ef_source: IFC India Construction Materials Database (2017), Table 14 -- Electrogalvanized steel sheet, CEA grid-adjusted.
steel_gi_galvanized.unit_note: Direct mass conversion: qty already in mass units (KG/KGS/MT), apply per-kg factor.

steel_stainless.ef_source: ICE Database v4.1 (Oct 2025), Steel material profile, row 'Steel, Stainless' -- average of 28 datapoints. No IFC India stainless-steel line exists; this is the only project data file with a stainless-steel figure.
steel_stainless.unit_note: Direct mass conversion: qty already in mass units (KG/KGS/MT), apply per-kg factor.

structural_steel.ef_source: IFC India Construction Materials Database (2017), Table 14, p.69 -- 'Steel section', CEA grid-adjusted.
structural_steel.unit_note: Direct mass conversion: qty already in mass units (KG/KGS/MT), apply per-kg factor.
